title: One viral key overloads its shard however many shards you add
caption: hash(key) always picks the same shard, so the key's whole request rate lands on one node while the rest idle.

steps.text: A million requests a second arrive, and half of them are for one viral video.
Every request for video:42 hashes to shard 0, which needs ~500k ops/s from a node that does ~100k.
The other shards share the long tail and sit mostly idle: the average looks healthy, the maximum doesn't.
Video:42's neighbours on shard 0 time out too. Going to 8 shards moves video:42 somewhere else, still to exactly one node.
